items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Oh, Charlie Seagher, you know, Charlie Seagher, you know, he'd get, play trumpet with me and I'd play piano.

ctx.x: Oh, I didn't know about him.

Yeah, well he got killed as a wreck. Yeah, yeah, yeah, you knew he was a trumpet band too. He was trumpet and piano, he was double trumpet and piano together. Oh, he was great. I never knew him. He came from Lake Charles, didn't he? That's right, that's where I formed a band in Lake Charles. Oh, Charlie Seagher, you know, Charlie Seagher, you know, he'd get, play trumpet with me and I'd play piano. Then he'd put the horn down, get on the piano, trumpet too and double ups. Double ups. Double ups, like that. That…
Well, I played some good ones. We might ask D.D. a little bit more about some of his bands now.
